services.name: 2 Hour - UTV Adventure Rental
services.desc: Sand Hollow - UTV Adventure Rental Elevate your next adventure on a thrilling UTV/ATV ride from Mad Moose Rentals & Tours in Sand Hollow State Park! Navigate over 50,000 acres of local trails, red rocks, and dunes, offering the most diverse off-road destination in the country. We are located at the Sand Hollow trailhead, so no trailer is required! Included Vehicle Helmets & Goggles Premium Damage Waiver ($1,500 Max Out of Pocket) Digital Map w/Recommendations Please Note: There is a mandatory gas charge based on the duration of your rental. A damage deposit is required with EVERY machine rental ($1,500 Authorized Damage Deposit). This will be collected upon arrival by credit/debit card
